critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~970 lines — still over the 700-line threshold recommended in iter-6 review. Consider splitting into routers/ subdirectory as growth continues (documenti_richiesti was added inline: DocumentoRichiesto model + DOC_DEFAULT constant + setdefault fallback in 2 GET endpoints).

Backend POST /pratiche/{id}/documenti — 'tipo' is inferred as a query param (FastAPI default), not documented as such in the signature. Frontend correctly uses '?tipo={docId}'; consider annotating with Query() for clarity and OpenAPI schema.

FormBuilder addDoc uses slugId(label) — no length check or reserved-word check; if user enters an empty-slug label (e.g. only special chars), id becomes empty string and doc-row-{empty} may collide. Low priority — real users unlikely to hit this.

get_template_spazio + get_template use `setdefault('documenti_richiesti', DOC_DEFAULT)` — this only fires if the field is MISSING, not empty. If a comune saves a template with `documenti_richiesti: []` (explicit empty), the fallback does NOT apply and users see 0 upload fields. This is likely INTENDED (Comune's choice) but worth documenting: 'to reset to 3 defaults, delete the field via direct DB write' — not possible via UI.
seed_osp.py runs stand-alone (`asyncio.run(main())`) — not wired into app startup. Requires manual re-execution if OSP fields/docs change. Consider integrating into seed_all() for idempotency.
